settings.editor: Our equipment rental solutions are designed for large-scale commercial, industrial, and infrastructure projects. We provide not just the heavy-duty machinery required to move massive volumes of terrain, but also the strategic execution necessary to ensure site preparations are completed strictly on schedule and under perfectly safe conditions.

Whether you require foundation excavation, trenching, rough grading, or total land clearing, our fleet of Tier-4 compliant excavators, bulldozers, and articulated dump trucks guarantees unmatched material handling capabilities. Every operation is backed by rigorous telematics tracking to optimize fuel burn and operational efficiency directly impacting your bottom line.
Utilizing advanced GPS and laser-grading attachments for exact subgrade leveling.
Mass excavation strategies designed to maximize load times and rapid hauling.
We believe in a calculated approach to earthmoving. Our process guarantees precision from the initial land survey to the final grade sign-off.
Extensive drone and laser surveys to calculate exact cut-and-fill volumes before a single bucket drops.
Dispatching the exact mix of dozers, excavators, and haulers based strictly on operational capacity needs.
24/7 monitoring of machine health, fuel usage, and operator efficiency during active earthmoving.

sg_accordion_list.sg_accordion_list_title: Do you provide operators with the equipment?
sg_accordion_list.sg_accordion_list_content: Rigrent primarily focuses on bare rental (equipment only). However, we maintain a vast network of certified operators and can facilitate operated-rentals for specialized long-term earthmoving contracts upon request.

sg_accordion_list.sg_accordion_list_title: How quickly can earthmoving equipment be deployed?
sg_accordion_list.sg_accordion_list_content: For emergency or rapid-response needs, our logistics network can deploy standard excavators and dozers to your site within 24 hours of contract approval within our primary operating zones.
Many of our late-model dozers and motor graders come pre-wired for Topcon and Trimble systems. Full GPS modules can be bolted on and calibrated prior to delivery for an additional fee.
